Fundul stâncos și pietros oferă condiții excelente pentru o apă limpede, ideală pentru înot și snorkeling. Încălțămintea robustă este foarte recomandată pentru acces și pentru plimbările de-a lungul pietrelor.

en.text: Plage de la Mala is a picturesque beach located in Val Thore within the Principality of Monaco. Nestled among the coastal cliffs, this spot provides a highly exclusive and luxurious atmosphere. Crystal-clear waters invite you to swim and sunbathe against a breathtaking backdrop. A visit is particularly recommended in the summer, though you should anticipate a short hike to reach the shore.

en.name: Marquet Beach
en.text: Marquet Beach is a well-maintained swimming spot in the urban area of Val Thore in Monaco. It radiates a sporty and family-friendly atmosphere that attracts plenty of visitors. The shallow access into the sea makes it ideal for swimming, while the beach promenade invites leisurely strolls. Arriving in the morning is highly advisable if you want to secure a front-row spot.

en.text: Plage du Solarium in Val Thore is an artificially created bathing platform on the coast of Monaco. This architecturally unique spot offers an urban and modern atmosphere for sheer relaxation. Steps lead directly into deep water for swimming, and the smooth surfaces are perfect for sunbathing. Bringing plenty of sun protection and taking care when entering the water is crucial, as there is no natural shade.

Guests can swim completely undisturbed in the sea, soak up the sun on comfortable loungers, and expect excellent service. Booking your beach visit well in advance is highly recommended to avoid any disappointment.

descriptionAdvanced.de: Das Viertel Jardin Exotique und der angrenzende Bereich Val Thore in Monaco stellen einen der spektakulärsten Wohnbezirke des Fürstentums dar. Gelegen an den steilen Hängen der Seealpen, bietet diese Zone atemberaubende Panoramablicke auf das Mittelmeer und den Felsen von Monaco. Das Herzstück ist der weltberühmte Jardin Exotique, der 1933 eröffnet wurde und eine einzigartige Sammlung von Sukkulenten und Kakteen aus aller Welt beherbergt. Die Architektur in diesem Viertel ist geprägt von modernen Luxusresidenzen wie dem Tour Simona, die sich harmonisch in das vertikale Relief der Klippen einfügen. Neben den botanischen Schätzen beherbergt das Viertel auch die Observatoriums-Grotte, eine prähistorische Höhle mit beeindruckenden Stalaktiten und Stalagmiten. Aufgrund seiner Höhenlage ist das Viertel durch ein ausgeklügeltes System von öffentlichen Aufzügen und Rolltreppen mit dem Hafenviertel La Condamine verbunden. Val Thore und Jardin Exotique gelten als ruhigere Wohngegenden, die dennoch alle Annehmlichkeiten des modernen Stadtlebens im Fürstentum bieten.
descriptionAdvanced.hu: A Jardin Exotique negyed és a hozzá kapcsolódó Val Thore terület Monaco egyik leglátványosabb lakóövezete a Hercegségben. A Tengeri-Alpok meredek lejtőin elhelyezkedő zóna lélegzetelállító panorámát nyújt a Földközi-tengerre és a monacói sziklára. A negyed központja a világhírű Jardin Exotique (Egzotikus Kert), amelyet 1933-ban nyitottak meg, és a világ minden tájáról származó pozsgás növények és kaktuszok egyedülálló gyűjteményének ad otthont. Az építészetet itt a modern luxusrezidenciák jellemzik, mint például a Tour Simona, amely harmonikusan illeszkedik a sziklák függőleges domborzatához. A botanikai kincsek mellett a negyedben található a Csillagvizsgáló-barlang is, egy őskori barlang lenyűgöző sztalaktitokkal és sztalagmitokkal. Magas fekvése miatt a negyedet egy kifinomult nyilvános lift- és mozgólépcső-rendszer köti össze a La Condamine kikötői negyeddel. Val Thore és a Jardin Exotique csendesebb lakóövezetnek számít, amely ennek ellenére a modern városi élet minden kényelmét biztosítja a Hercegségben.
descriptionAdvanced.ro: Cartierul Jardin Exotique și zona adiacentă Val Thore din Monaco reprezintă una dintre cele mai spectaculoase zone rezidențiale ale Principatului. Situată pe versanții abrupți ai Alpilor Maritimi, această zonă oferă vederi panoramice uluitoare asupra Mării Mediterane și a Stâncii Monaco. Piesa centrală este faimoasa grădină Jardin Exotique, deschisă în 1933, care găzduiește o colecție unică de plante suculente și cactuși din întreaga lume. Arhitectura din acest cartier este marcată de rezidențe de lux moderne, precum Tour Simona, care se integrează armonios în relieful vertical al falezelor. Pe lângă comorile botanice, cartierul găzduiește și Grota Observatorului, o peșteră preistorică cu stalactite și stalagmite impresionante. Datorită altitudinii sale, cartierul este conectat de zona portuară La Condamine printr-un sistem ingenios de lifturi și scări rulante publice. Val Thore și Jardin Exotique sunt considerate zone rezidențiale mai liniștite, oferind totuși toate facilitățile vieții urbane moderne din Principat.
descriptionAdvanced.en: The Jardin Exotique district and the adjacent Val Thore area in Monaco constitute one of the most spectacular residential sectors of the Principality. Situated on the steep slopes of the Maritime Alps, this zone offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Mediterranean Sea and the Rock of Monaco. The centerpiece is the world-renowned Jardin Exotique, opened in 1933, which houses a unique collection of succulents and cacti from all over the globe. Architecture in this neighborhood is characterized by modern luxury residences, such as the Tour Simona, which blend harmoniously into the vertical cliff relief. Beyond botanical treasures, the district also contains the Observatory Cave, a prehistoric cave system featuring impressive stalactites and stalagmites. Due to its elevated position, the neighborhood is linked to the La Condamine harbor area by a sophisticated system of public elevators and escalators. Val Thore and Jardin Exotique are regarded as quieter residential enclaves that nonetheless provide all the luxuries of modern urban living in the Principality.
